title: Add Network coordinator and worker at-a-glance dashboards
summary: Add role-tabbed Coordinator and Worker dashboard summaries to the existing WebView Network page using already-loaded queue and network worker evidence.
reason: The Network page had detailed lifecycle, settings, and persisted-state panels, but did not give the operator a fast answer for which files are active, what is queued, and what the local worker is doing.
behavior_before: Network workers, lifecycle, and settings evidence were visible, but active claimed work and queue/on-deck state were split across detailed text/table panels.
behavior_after: The Network page leads with Coordinator and Worker at-a-glance tabs that summarize active claimed files, queue/on-deck files, local worker claim state, pending done reports, lifecycle route posture, and state-file evidence without adding new backend mutation authority.
manual_validation: temporary local API on 127.0.0.1:7861 served the WebView; in-app Browser verified Network page defaulted to Worker for saved NetworkRole=worker, Coordinator/Worker tabs switched correctly, overview panels rendered live queue/worker evidence, and browser console warnings/errors were empty; temporary API was stopped after verification
pytest target command could not run because apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe has no pytest module installed
mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries - passed twice; first run wrote 7 summaries and final run wrote 1 networkView summary

validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed only for unrelated uncovered files: docs/generated/dependency-atlas/assets/dependency_detail_core_library.png, docs/generated/dependency-atlas/assets/dependency_detail_core_library.svg, docs/generated/dependency-atlas/assets/dependency_detail_desktop_watch.png, docs/generated/dependency-atlas/assets/dependency_detail_desktop_watch.svg, src/mediapipeline/core/network/facade.py
rollback_plan: Remove the Network Coordinator/Worker tab markup, model/render helpers, queue payload wiring, CSS, and test updates; restore the prior Network page panel order expectations.
notes:
Phase 1 is frontend-only and composes existing /api/queue and /api/network/workers read payloads. It does not add Local API routes, queue mutation, lifecycle mutation, media policy, FFmpeg/subtitle/audio behavior, publish/drain behavior, source/scratch/output movement, or cleanup behavior.
The worktree had extensive pre-existing dirty files before this UI change; coverage validation should distinguish this packet from unrelated uncovered edits. A later coverage rerun also reported src/mediapipeline/core/network/facade.py as uncovered; that backend connectivity diff is unrelated to this frontend dashboard packet.
